Walking them to the door

Walking them to the door.

People remember how a visit ends more than the middle, so a few extra steps to the door can shape the whole evening.

For whoever walks the guest all the way out.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one next to it. The black one says I'll walk you. The blue one says you don't have to, then the black one says I want to, and both walk toward the door together. The door opens, the blue one walks out as the black one says careful out there, and the door closes. The black one is left with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me walking them to the door. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
